mapper.sql: F.QSTNR_SN, F.QSTNR_TYPE_CD, F.EVL_SE_CD, CASE F.EVL_SE_CD WHEN 'STUDENT' THEN '학생' WHEN 'TEACHER' THEN '선생님 운영' ELSE F.EVL_SE_CD END AS EVL_SE_NM, F.QSTNR_NM, F.REG_DT, F.RGTR_NM, F.MDFCN_DT, F.MDFR_NM, F.DEL_DT, F.DLTR_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_QSTNR_MST ( QSTNR_TYPE_CD, EVL_SE_CD, QSTNR_NM, RGTR_NM, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{qstnrTypeCd}, #{evlSeCd}, #{qstnrNm}, #{rgtr}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_QSTNR_MST SET EVL_SE_CD = #{evlSeCd}, QSTNR_NM = #{qstnrNm}, MDFR_NM = #{mdtr}, MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE QSTNR_SN = #{qstnrSn} AND QSTNR_TYPE_CD = #{qstnrTypeCd} AND DEL_DT IS NULL
UPDATE EDU_QSTNR_MST SET DEL_DT = NOW(), DLTR_NM = 'admin' WHERE QSTNR_SN = #{qstnrSn} AND QSTNR_TYPE_CD = 'EVAL' AND DEL_DT IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT Q.QSTN_SN, Q.QSTNR_SN, Q.QSTN_NO, Q.ANS_TYPE_CD, CASE Q.ANS_TYPE_CD WHEN 'LIKERT5' THEN '리커트 5점' WHEN 'LEVEL5' THEN '상중하 5단계' WHEN 'TEXT' THEN '주관식' ELSE Q.ANS_TYPE_CD END AS ANS_TYPE_NM, Q.QSTN_CN, Q.SORT_SEQ, Q.REG_DT, Q.RGTR_NM, Q.MDFCN_DT, Q.MDFR_NM FROM EDU_QSTNR_QSTN Q WHERE Q.QSTNR_SN = #{qstnrSn} ORDER BY Q.SORT_SEQ ASC, Q.QSTN_SN ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_QSTNR_QSTN ( QSTNR_SN, QSTN_NO, ANS_TYPE_CD, QSTN_CN, SORT_SEQ, RGTR_NM, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{qstnrSn}, #{qstnNo}, #{ansTypeCd}, #{qstnCn}, #{sortSeq}, #{rgtr}, NOW() )
